summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the de facto open standard for connecting AI agents to external tools, data sources, and services, with its TypeScript and Python SDKs reaching 97 million monthly downloads by March 2026 — a 4,750% growth in 16 months. The ecosystem spans aggregator platforms that bundle thousands of integrations, gateways that secure and proxy MCP traffic, and individual servers for specific tools like browsers, repos, and design files. This matters because MCP eliminates custom per-tool integrations, letting AI agents securely discover and call real-world capabilities through a single standardized protocol.
ecosystem_note: Aggregators (like Composio and Smithery) bundle hundreds-to-thousands of MCP integrations behind one managed endpoint, gateways (like Cloudflare and agentgateway) sit in front of MCP servers to add auth, routing, and security, while individual servers (like Playwright or GitHub MCP) expose a single tool or service.

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation and control — navigation, clicks, form filling, screenshots, E2E testing, and session management for AI agents driving a real browser
strengths: Highest search volume of any MCP server (~35,000 monthly global searches)
Backed by Microsoft's mature Playwright framework
Accessibility-tree based automation without screenshots
Strong for AI-driven E2E testing and web scraping
tools.best_for: AI agents that need reliable, structured browser automation and web testing

tools.name: Figma MCP
tools.connects_to: Figma design files — reads design context, components, layout, and styles so agents can generate code from designs (design-to-code)
tools.pricing_paid: Included with Figma plans; Dev Mode features require paid Figma seats (from ~$12/editor/mo)
strengths: ~23,000 monthly global searches — top design-focused server
Official OAuth-secured remote MCP server
Bridges design and code for AI coding agents
First-party support from Figma
tools.best_for: Turning Figma designs into production code via AI agents in IDEs

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions, and code search — lets agents read/write repos and manage dev workflows
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source; usage follows GitHub plan limits
strengths: ~17,000 monthly global searches
Official OAuth-secured remote MCP server
Core to agentic coding workflows (issue triage, PR review, code search)
Deep integration across the GitHub platform
tools.best_for: AI coding agents managing repos, issues, and CI/CD workflows

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: 1,500+ apps and tools (Slack, GitHub, Gmail, Notion, Jira, databases) through a single managed MCP endpoint with built-in auth
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based paid tiers for higher tool-call volume and team features
strengths: 1B+ tool calls run on the platform
Self-learning layer improves tool selection and token efficiency over time (30% more accurate on 2x fewer tokens for repeat tasks)
Managed OAuth and auth handling across 1,500+ apps
Single endpoint eliminates per-tool setup
tools.best_for: Production agents needing broad, managed app integrations without maintaining each server

tools.name: Context7
tools.connects_to: Up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples injected into AI coding agents' context
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier; paid plans for higher rate limits
strengths: ~13,000 monthly global searches
Solves outdated-docs hallucination in coding agents
Remote server option, easy drop-in for IDEs
Covers thousands of libraries and frameworks
tools.best_for: Giving coding agents current, accurate library documentation

tools.name: Supabase MCP
tools.connects_to: Supabase Postgres databases, auth, storage, and edge functions — lets agents query data, manage schemas, and run migrations
tools.pricing_paid: Free with Supabase free tier; scales with Supabase paid plans (from $25/mo)
strengths: ~11,000 monthly global searches
Official OAuth-secured remote MCP server
Full-stack backend access (DB, auth, storage) in one server
Popular with AI app-building workflows
tools.best_for: AI agents building and managing full-stack apps on Supabase

tools.name: Notion MCP
tools.connects_to: Notion pages, databases, and workspaces — read/write docs, query databases, and manage knowledge bases
tools.pricing_paid: Included with Notion plans; advanced use follows Notion paid tiers (from ~$10/user/mo)
strengths: ~9,500 monthly global searches
Official OAuth-secured remote MCP server
Connects agents to team knowledge and docs
First-party support from Notion
tools.best_for: Agents managing docs, wikis, and knowledge workflows in Notion

tools.name: n8n MCP
tools.connects_to: n8n workflow automation — lets agents trigger and build automation workflows across 400+ app integrations
strengths: ~9,200 monthly global searches
Bridges AI agents with powerful workflow automation
Self-hostable for full control
Large existing n8n integration catalog
tools.best_for: Connecting agents to automated multi-step workflows and integrations

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP
tools.connects_to: Remote MCP server hosting plus access to Cloudflare Workers, D1, R2, KV, and OAuth-secured remote server deployment
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier via Workers; paid Workers/platform usage scales with volume
strengths: First-class platform for deploying remote, OAuth-secured MCP servers
Built-in auth, edge hosting, and global distribution
Eliminates local install and credential leakage risk
Strong for production and CI environments
tools.best_for: Deploying and hosting remote MCP servers at the edge with built-in auth

tools.name: Zapier MCP
tools.connects_to: 8,000+ apps via Zapier's integration catalog — lets agents trigger actions across the widest app ecosystem
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier; paid Zapier plans scale with task volume (from ~$20/mo)
strengths: ~6,700 monthly global searches
Largest app integration catalog (8,000+ apps)
Remote server with managed auth
No-code setup familiar to millions of Zapier users
tools.best_for: Agents needing the broadest possible reach across SaaS apps

tools.name: Jira MCP
tools.connects_to: Jira issues, projects, sprints, and boards — lets agents create, query, and update tickets and manage project workflows
tools.pricing_paid: Included with Atlassian plans; scales with Jira paid tiers
strengths: ~6,100 monthly global searches
Official OAuth-secured remote MCP server
Core to engineering project management workflows
First-party Atlassian support
tools.best_for: Agents managing issue tracking and agile project workflows

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: Registry and hosting for thousands of MCP servers — discover, deploy, and connect community and official servers from one hub
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier; paid hosting/usage plans for scaled deployments
strengths: Largest MCP server registry and discovery hub
One-click deployment and hosting of MCP servers
Central place to find vetted community servers
Growing rapidly as the ecosystem's package-registry layer
tools.best_for: Discovering, deploying, and hosting MCP servers from a single registry
